name: Boku no Oukoku
source:
Kane is a shepherd. One day, he meets Elith, the spirit of the earth. Kane follows Elith's prediction and saves Princess Sharlot, who has been kept hostage by bandits. His brave action is highly appreciated and he becomes the leader of Norland...

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090228132313/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012195]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
牧羊少年凯恩某天邂逅了大地精灵艾莉丝，并在艾莉丝预言的指引下，成功救出了遭山贼挟持为人质的夏洛特公主。他的英勇壮举赢得了众人的高度赞誉，凯恩也由此被推举为诺兰德的领袖……
